text:
A: Hiya! You've got the dog, haven't you? I remember from your picture.
B: Ha, yes, hello! That's Biscuit, she's just behind me on the sofa. I'm Gemma.
A: I'm Jade, Barnsley. Oh my god, Biscuit! The girl I just talked to, her guinea pig's called Biscuit.
B: No! Was that Megan? With the bird chart?
A: Yeah! She were lovely.
B: Well, I'll take that as a good sign. Erm, what kind of dog have you got? I think I saw a toy in your picture.
A: Staffy, Bella. She destroys everything. She chewed the remote again this week, the second one this year.
B: Oh no. Biscuit's the opposite, she's a greyhound and she's scared of everything. The hoover, carrier bags, the cat next door. She's thirteen and she just sleeps, really.
A: Aw, bless her.
B: So what do you do, Jade? Sorry, I'm terrible, I just launch in.
A: No, you're fine. I were a nail tech, but the salon shut, so I'm kind of looking at the minute. I want to do nails from home, I just need to sort it all out properly, like insurance and that.
B: Your nails look gorgeous, though. Did you do those?
A: Yeah, last night. Thank you.
B: I'd love nice nails, but I can't have them at work, I'm in a hospital. Pharmacy. I'm a technician, I check prescriptions on the wards. So it's all short and plain, I'm afraid.
A: Oh, that's a shame. You could do them for holidays, like press-ons.
B: Ooh, I hadn't thought of that. We go to Crete in June.
A: See! Done. Is your husband in a hospital as well?
B: No, he's an electrician.
A: Shut up, so's mine! Liam. He's in Wakefield all week.
B: That's funny, because the lad I talked to before was an electrician as well. Zain. There's sparkies everywhere today.
A: Ha, it's like a convention. Does yours leave his tools all over the house?
B: Always. There's a drill on our kitchen table right now, I've just moved it off camera.
A: Same! There's like cables in my bathroom.
B: Erm, do you do much with your days, then, while you're looking? Sorry, that sounds nosy.
A: Nah, it's fine. Walk Bella, bit of telly. Love Island, that kind of thing. I joined a gym in January, been about four times.
B: Ha, that's four more than most people! I do parkrun on a Saturday, but that's only because there's coffee after.
A: Honestly, that's the only reason I'd go.
B: Have you got anywhere you could do the nails from? Like a spare room?
A: Yeah, the spare room. It's full of boxes, though. Kit's all in there.
B: Well, that's half of it done, if you've got the kit. Oh, I think we're nearly up.
A: Aw, already? It's been dead nice.
